title: Retail Price & MAP Watch
summary: Scheduled competitor price monitoring with smart matching, noise filtering, MAP breach evidence, and alerts only when a change is meaningful.
problem: Brands drown in price alerts from penny moves, bad cross-site matches, and MAP violations that turn out to be used listings or parse failures.
solution: Monitor multiple retailer adapters on a schedule, match SKUs with GTIN/MPN plus guarded fuzzy titles (conflicts go to a review queue), confirm significant moves before alerting, and attach screenshot evidence for MAP breaches. Includes source health for rate limits and challenge pages, plus CSV/Excel export and Telegram/Slack/email hooks. Demo runs on synthetic sandbox retailers offline.
